sentences.en: Nevertheless, he dauntlessly took action to open a great and eternal path of hope for all humankind.

sentences.en: I will seek it and march along, on and on! "Everyone has his own way to success . On this way, we must summon up our courage and energy and head on dauntlessly !"

sentences.en: When facing choice, if we can remember the girl who was ever standing there dauntlessly ?
